title: Improving Sketching Algorithms for Low-Rank Matrix Approximation via Sketch-Power Iterations
summary: Power iteration can improve the accuracy of randomized SVD, but requires multiple data passes, making it impractical in streaming or memory-constrained settings. We introduce a lightweight yet effective sketch-power iteration, allowing power-like iterations with only a single pass of the data, which can be incorporated into one-pass algorithms for low-rank approximation. As an example, we integrate the sketch-power iteration into a one-pass algorithm proposed by Tropp et al., and introduce strategies to reduce its storage cost.
